## Description

Describe what changed and why.

## Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Release, CI, or repository maintenance

## User Impact

Describe affected commands, prompts, process handling, services, or installation flows.

## Terminal Output

Include concise output for CLI presentation changes.

## Safety and Dependencies

- [ ] Preview-first behavior remains intact.
- [ ] Destructive behavior requires explicit authorization.
- [ ] No runtime dependencies were added.
- [ ] New or changed dependencies are justified.
- [ ] Security-sensitive behavior is described.

## Validation

- [ ] `mise run check` passes.
- [ ] CLI E2E tests pass when command behavior changes.
- [ ] Isolated process E2E tests pass when cleanup behavior changes.
- [ ] `mise run release-preview` passes for release-sensitive changes.
- [ ] New behavior has regression coverage.

## Release Notes

Provide one or two release-note bullets, or write `None`.
